encounters.name: Brawl at the Drowned Lantern
encounters.briefing: Chairs scrape back. The Grey Company's bruisers come at you with fists, chair legs and bottles. Nobody here wants a killing: knock them flat (a melee hit that drops a foe to 0 knocks it out).
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F1: 4 bruisers on Medium. Easy −1 / Hard +1 is my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Ambush on the Ashford road
encounters.briefing: Smoke-smudged goblins have been raiding the river road. Tracks and a snapped bowstring warn you before they burst from the treeline.

encounters.name: The warren gate
encounters.briefing: Two half-starved wolves are chained at the warren's mouth, and goblin archers watch from the rocks behind them.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F3: 2 wolves + 2 goblins on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Grisk's hall
encounters.briefing: Grisk Two-Teeth rises from a throne of stolen mine carts. His goblins grab spears; the captured miners shout from a pen at the back.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F4: Grisk (hobgoblin) + 3 goblins on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: The mine mouth
encounters.briefing: Hollow Star diggers drop their picks and pick up knives. Their foreman, a scarred thug, plants himself in front of the shaft.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F5: 4 cultists + 1 thug on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: The Deep Seam
encounters.briefing: The seam is warm as a bread oven. Pale centipedes as long as a man pour out of cracks in the old Ammarindar stone.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F6: 4 giant centipedes on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: The sunken shrine
encounters.briefing: Brother Ulric stands at the drowned altar with the shard in his hook-hand. The skeletons of Varrow's old miners rise from the water, helmet-lamps flickering. You can still try to talk him down mid-fight.

parley.text: Ulric lowers his hook. "Brannoc's crew… the widows' pensions…" The skeletons sag back into the water. "Enough. Take the cursed thing."

encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F7: Ulric + 4 skeletons (Hard at L3). Parley DCs (15, 11 with Brannoc's name) are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Brannoc's cellar
encounters.briefing: The trapdoor opens on a heaving carpet of rats. Beneath the barrels, an old dwarf tunnel breathes warm air.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: 2 swarms of rats + 4 giant rats on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Wolves in the Ashwood
encounters.briefing: Three grey wolves, ribs showing, have been following you for a mile. Now they stop pretending.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: 3 wolves (Easy at L2). Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Shadows in the mill
encounters.briefing: The shadows peel off the walls, three of them, the shapes of a man, a woman and a boy. Ordinary weapons barely touch them; magic and radiant light do.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: 3 shadows (Hard at L2). Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: The luck-stone shrine
encounters.briefing: The luck-stone sits in a niche of goblin skulls and copper pots. Its hobgoblin keeper and two goblins were waiting for a thief.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: hobgoblin + 2 goblins on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Scald
encounters.briefing: A dog-sized red dragon, eggshell still stuck to one horn, rears up on a hoard of stolen copper pots. Spread out: its fire breath fills a 15-foot cone. ☠ Deadly at level 2, Hard at level 3.
encounters.verifyNote: Items.md Elites: red dragon wyrmling (275 XP/PC bonus). One wyrmling on every difficulty [inferred].

encounters.name: The toll bridge
encounters.briefing: Three Grey Company bruisers and a scout with a longbow hold the bridge. The river is too deep and fast to wade.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F8: 3 thugs + 1 scout on Medium. Easy drops a thug and Hard adds a second scout (bot tests: a 4th thug was a wipe) [inferred].

encounters.name: Lizardfolk hunting grounds
encounters.briefing: Three lizardfolk hunters rise out of the reeds, clubs and shields ready. Deep water blocks the way around.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F9: 3 lizardfolk. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Drowned Marrowmere
encounters.briefing: The village's dead stand up out of the warm bog: four bloated zombies, and something quicker behind them. Radiant damage and critical hits stop zombies for good.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F10: 1 ghoul + 4 zombies on Medium. Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Marrowmere chapel
encounters.briefing: Three ghouls crouch over the chapel's broken pews. Their claws paralyze (Con save); elves are immune.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F11: 3 ghouls (Hard at L3). Easy/Hard changes are my pick [inferred].

encounters.name: Betrayal at Ashford Hall
encounters.briefing: The Hall doors bang shut behind you. Captain Voss of the Hall guard draws a longsword; a hired thug blocks the windows.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F12: hall captain (veteran) + thug. Hard adds a thug [inferred]; Easy keeps both.

encounters.name: Betrayal at Ashford Hall (exposed)
encounters.briefing: With the ledger read aloud, the thug drops his club and runs. Only Captain Voss still stands by the mayor.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F12: smaller if Tarrow was exposed early (veteran only) [inferred].

encounters.name: The abbey cloister
encounters.briefing: A cult fanatic and three cultists hold the cloister garden, knives out among the dead roses.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F13: cult fanatic + 3 cultists on Medium [inferred Easy/Hard].

encounters.name: The abbey undercroft
encounters.briefing: Sister Venna waits at the drowned altar with the second shard. An ogre in a hollow-star tabard lumbers out of the dark, and two cultists flank her. She calls on the spirits: stay out of her reach if you can.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F14: Venna (priest) + ogre + 2 cultists (Hard at L4) [inferred Easy/Hard].

encounters.name: Mother Sallow
encounters.briefing: The kindly old woman's face slides off like wet paper. A green hag claws at you, and the bog's insects rise in two humming clouds.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: green hag + 2 swarms of insects (Hard at L4) [inferred Easy/Hard].

encounters.name: Deserters' camp
encounters.briefing: Sergeant Holm and his three deserters won't go back to Kell in chains. They draw steel.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: bandit captain + 3 bandits on Medium [inferred Easy/Hard].

encounters.name: The flooded crypt
encounters.briefing: Two specters drift up out of the black water, and a ghast that stinks of the grave guards the founder's tomb. Their touch drains your maximum HP until a long rest.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: 2 specters + 1 ghast (Hard at L4) [inferred Easy/Hard].

encounters.name: Ambush in Cobbler's Lane
encounters.briefing: Venna's enforcers have Edric pinned against a wall: a fanatic with a hooked knife and three cultists.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: cult fanatic + 3 cultists on Medium [inferred Easy/Hard].

encounters.name: The Drowned Abbot
encounters.briefing: The last abbot rises from his flooded tomb, a wraith in rotted vestments, with the specter of a novice at his side. ☠ Deadly at level 4, Hard at level 5. His touch drains maximum HP.
encounters.verifyNote: Items.md Elites: wraith + 1 specter (500 XP/PC bonus). Same on every difficulty [inferred].

encounters.name: Ashfall Pass
encounters.briefing: Two ogres, singed and starving, have rolled boulders across the pass. They want food. All of it.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F15: 2 ogres (Medium at L4). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The Kiln Gate
encounters.briefing: Two gargoyles peel themselves off the gate's pillars. Ordinary weapons barely scratch them.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F16: 2 gargoyles (Medium at L4). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The Kiln Gate (Kell holds the rear)
encounters.briefing: Kell's company holds the cult's rearguard off your backs. Only one gargoyle stirs on the gate.
encounters.verifyNote: Story_Bible Act III: if Kell respects you the gate fight gets smaller [inferred: one gargoyle].

encounters.name: The Furnace Halls
encounters.briefing: Three suits of Varrow's forge-guard armor clank to life between the cold furnaces.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F17: 3 animated armor (Medium at L4). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: Hall of the Honor Guard
encounters.briefing: Ser Ida Marrow, dead two hundred years, draws her sword. Two suits of guard-armor and a skeletal squire close ranks with her.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F18: Ida (wight) + 2 animated armor + 1 skeleton (Medium at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The Ember Galleries
encounters.briefing: A wall of Ammarindar stone with a dwarf's face carved in it pulls itself free. A magma mephit cackles in the lava light.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F19: earth elemental + magma mephit (Medium at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The Star's last stand
encounters.briefing: The last of Venna's zealots hold the stair to the Crowning: two fanatics and four cultists, with nothing left to lose.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F20: 2 cult fanatics + 4 cultists (Medium at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The Star's last stand (the back way)
encounters.briefing: You come in behind them through the back way. Only half the zealots are where they can reach you.
encounters.verifyNote: Story_Bible Act III: Ulric's passage (or Wix's back way) skips half of this fight [inferred: 1 fanatic + 2 cultists].

encounters.name: The Crowning: Maelis
encounters.briefing: Maelis stands in the burning heart of the mountain with the half-forged crown. She won't be talked down now. She is a trained mage: spread out against her fire.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F21 phase 1: Maelis (mage). Hard adds a zealot [inferred].

encounters.name: The Crowning: Cindrath
encounters.briefing: Cindrath tears herself half out of the stone: an ember-wraith of smoke and molten gold, bound to the ritual circle. She can't leave it, but her breath fills a 30-ft cone. Strike the three crown shards: every blow on a shard wounds her too.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP F21 phase 2: the ember-wraith (homebrew; CR 6–7 budget). Shards and their HP are my design [inferred].

encounters.name: The Ember Queen
encounters.briefing: The crown closes on Maelis's head, and Cindrath wears her. The Ember Queen rises in the circle, burning. Strike the shards.
encounters.verifyNote: Story_Bible §8: The Ember Queen. Same ember-wraith block [inferred].

encounters.name: The Ember Heir
encounters.briefing: Corin's eyes go molten gold. Cindrath has found a new host, and it is your friend. Strike the shards to cut her out of him.
encounters.verifyNote: Story_Bible §9: The Ember Heir. Corin sits this fight out; ember-wraith block [inferred].

encounters.name: The Cold Forge
encounters.briefing: The forge's guardian wakes in the lava tubes: a fire elemental, and two magma mephits riding the heat.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: fire elemental + 2 magma mephits (Hard at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The ossuary
encounters.briefing: Two ghasts and four ghouls have been feeding in the ossuary for two hundred years. The stench alone is a weapon.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: 2 ghasts + 4 ghouls (Hard at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The evacuation convoy
encounters.briefing: Two hell hounds, born of the mountain's heat, come baying down the river road at the carts.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: 2 hell hounds (Medium at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: The giant at the door
encounters.briefing: A hill giant has wedged itself into the clan's front door, with an ogre to fetch and carry.
encounters.verifyNote: Encounters_and_XP side quests: hill giant + ogre (Hard at L5). [inferred] Easy/Hard changes and the map are my pick.

encounters.name: Vorrag the Kiln-Smith
encounters.briefing: Vorrag the Kiln-Smith hefts a greatsword longer than you are tall. ☠ Deadly at level 5, Hard at level 6. Two huge sword blows a turn, and he throws rocks: spread out and use cover.
encounters.verifyNote: Items.md Elites: fire giant (1,250 XP/PC bonus). Same on every difficulty [inferred].

encounters.name: Starving wolves

encounters.verifyNote: Monsters and raw XP from Encounters_and_XP.md §5b; XP per character = raw ÷ 4 (§3). Easy removes one enemy and Hard adds one [inferred, D9 says Easy/Hard add or remove enemies]; map and positions are mine [inferred].

encounters.verifyNote: Monsters and raw XP from Encounters_and_XP.md §5b; XP per character = raw ÷ 4 (§3). Easy removes one enemy and Hard adds one [inferred, D9 says Easy/Hard add or remove enemies]; map and positions are mine [inferred].

talk.success: The goblins wolf down your rations and chatter about the mountain "breathing" at night. They scurry off happy.

talk.failure: They snatch the food and attack anyway!

8.text: No fight: a dwarven pilgrim bound for the Ammarindar ruins shares a rumor: the old dwarf-roads under the mountain are warm to the touch.
8.note: A dwarven pilgrim says the old dwarf-roads under the mountain are warm to the touch.

8.text: No fight: a lost novice from the abbey, Brother Tam, shares what he knows: the abbot's crypt was sealed with the sun of Lathander, and someone has scratched it out.
8.note: A lost novice says the drowned abbot's crypt was sealed with Lathander's sun, now scratched out.

8.text: No fight: a stone giant sits on a ridge, watching the Kiln smoke. It says one thing, slowly: "The burning crown wakes the old one. Do not let it close."
8.note: A stone giant watcher warned: 'The burning crown wakes the old one. Do not let it close.'
